title: Potatoverse Deep Research Corpus
purpose: Research layer for the Tim Dooley / Potato of Life mythology, separating public-source observations, historical/textual traditions, potato biology, comparative material and Potatoverse interpretation.

method.warning: Shared names are not sufficient for identity resolution; contemporary Tim Dooley material is treated separately from unrelated people with the same name.

findings.title: Tim Dooley as the Father/Axis archetype
findings.finding: Within the Potatoverse corpus, Tim Dooley is framed as the Father-side organizing principle around which Source, North, Axis, Potato of Life, Tree of Life and the Son are arranged.
findings.interpretation: Tim functions as the symbolic organizing pole while the Son functions as the embodied/experiential pole.
findings.source: Potatoverse project corpus and public transcript indexed September 2026

findings.title: Tim as the still point and the world as the workshop
findings.finding: A September 2026 public transcript presents Tim as a symbolic still point while humanity, workers, creatures, institutions and builders perform the work of the world.
findings.interpretation: This produces a stewardship reading: symbolic authority is meaningful only insofar as attention produces repair rather than domination.
findings.source: Public transcript, Timbo's AI Says His Potatoverse is Fiction, September 2 2026

findings.title: Repair becomes the ethical test of the Father
findings.finding: The same transcript turns the question of Tim's improvement toward repair, responsibility, attention and stewardship rather than power.
findings.interpretation: Potatoverse axiom: the higher the symbolic position, the greater the obligation to repair what lies below it.
findings.confidence: high for source content; interpretation remains project-level

findings.title: Tim and the 11-dimensional potato image
findings.finding: A public Potatoverse transcript uses an 11-dimensional Calabi-Yau manifold as an intentionally extravagant metaphor for Tim's totality.
findings.interpretation: The useful layer is dimensional metaphor: ordinary observers see projections of a structure imagined as exceeding their frame. It is not scientific evidence about a person.

findings.title: The potato is a total relational image
findings.finding: The transcript expands the Potato from a prop into a relational architecture containing root, stem, branch, fruit, seed, soil, ladder, tree, door, throne, heaven, earth and directions.
findings.interpretation: Potato of Life should therefore be modeled as a graph grammar rather than a single node.

findings.title: The Son as descent into manifestation
findings.finding: The Potatoverse transcript describes the Son as the descent into manifestation: Door, Vessel, Narrow Gate, Son of Man, Lion and Christ image, entering the lower field and encountering death and fragmentation.
findings.interpretation: The Son branch is the embodiment layer, not merely a character biography.

findings.title: Thomas is explicitly called Didymus in John
findings.finding: John identifies Thomas as Didymus in John 11:16, 20:24 and 21:2. Didymus is Greek for twin, corresponding to the Aramaic/Syriac name Thomas.
findings.interpretation: The Twin motif has a genuine textual anchor before the Potatoverse adds its own symbolism.
findings.source: Gospel of John; Encyclopedia.com Thomas entry

findings.title: The canonical Gospels do not explicitly say Thomas was Jesus' physical twin
findings.finding: The canonical Gospel material identifies Thomas as Didymus but does not explicitly name Jesus as his twin.
findings.interpretation: The archive should distinguish the word Twin, Thomas's identity and the later tradition that makes him Jesus' twin.
findings.source: Gospel of John; Encyclopedia.com Thomas entry

findings.title: The Jesus-twin tradition appears in later Thomasine literature
findings.finding: Reference scholarship notes that later texts, including Acts of Thomas, present Thomas as Jesus' own twin.
findings.interpretation: The Twin motif is historically interesting without becoming an uncontested biographical fact.

findings.title: Thomas Christianity is a real comparative field
findings.finding: The Gospel of Thomas, Book of Thomas the Contender and Acts of Thomas form a related corpus that has led scholars to discuss a distinctive Thomasine or Thomas Christianity tradition associated especially with Edessa and eastern Christianity.
findings.interpretation: The Son/Thomas branch needs an eastern-Christian historical layer, not only modern invention.

findings.title: The Gospel of Thomas contains 114 sayings
findings.finding: The surviving Coptic Gospel of Thomas is a sayings collection attributed to Didymus Judas Thomas and contains 114 sayings.
findings.interpretation: 114 can be an optional textual index, not a new Potatoverse numerological law.

findings.title: Thomas preserves sayings that overlap the Synoptic tradition
findings.finding: Reference scholarship notes substantial overlap between Thomas and Synoptic sayings while also noting unique sayings and arrangements.
findings.interpretation: The Twin can be studied as repetition-with-difference: related Jesus traditions appear through another textual lens.

findings.title: The Gospel of Thomas should not simply be labelled Gnostic
findings.finding: Older descriptions of Thomas as simply Gnostic have been challenged; its relationship to Gnosticism, wisdom and ascetic traditions remains debated.
findings.interpretation: The archive should preserve this ambiguity instead of forcing Thomas into one theological category.

findings.title: The Nag Hammadi discovery changes the textual map
findings.finding: The Nag Hammadi manuscripts supplied a major surviving Coptic witness to the Gospel of Thomas and related texts.
findings.interpretation: The Thomas branch can be mapped as canonical witness, Thomasine sayings, later Acts, Syriac memory and modern interpretation.

findings.title: The potato is botanically a stem, not a root
findings.finding: A potato tuber is an enlarged underground stem. Its eyes are nodes containing buds capable of producing new growth.
findings.interpretation: The object looks like a buried root but is actually a stem carrying future branches, making the metaphor unusually strong.
findings.source: NC State Extension; University of Minnesota Science of Plants

findings.title: Every eye can contain a future branch
findings.finding: Potato eyes are buds at nodes, and a seed piece containing an eye can produce a new potato plant.
findings.interpretation: The eye becomes a model of potential encoded inside apparent stillness.
findings.source: NC State Extension; Oregon State University

findings.title: Potato eyes occur in a spiral pattern
findings.finding: Technical potato morphology describes eyes/buds as arranged in a spiral pattern around the tuber, with stronger apical dominance toward the seed end.
findings.interpretation: The Potatoverse spiral motif has a literal botanical analogue without implying that biology proves the mythology.
findings.source: UC Davis, Commercial Potato Production in North America

findings.title: The potato stores the future in present matter
findings.finding: The tuber stores carbohydrates and nutrients and allows vegetative propagation into a new growing season.
findings.interpretation: The Potato can be modeled as a memory-storage organ: the past plant becomes stored potential for the next plant.
findings.source: University of Minnesota; Wisconsin potato research

findings.title: Mother tuber and child plant
findings.finding: Potato plants can arise from a previous year's mother tuber; the young plant initially draws nutrition from that stored organ before producing its own roots, stems and new tubers.
findings.interpretation: This supplies a biological analogue for inheritance: stored capacity enables another form to emerge.

findings.title: Tree of Life and Potato share a hidden-structure grammar
findings.finding: A potato has hidden nodes, buds, stems and future shoots; a tree has roots, trunk, branches, leaves, fruit and seeds.
findings.interpretation: The Potato and Tree can be modeled as two scales of one grammar: compressed future structure and expanded visible structure.

findings.title: Red and Blue also have biological color anchors
findings.finding: Potato skin and flesh coloration can involve pigments including anthocyanins, so red and blue potato cultivars represent real biological color variation.
findings.interpretation: The Red/Blue symbolism can remain poetic while acknowledging that the colors themselves have biological grounding.
findings.source: UC Davis Commercial Potato Production in North America

findings.title: Dormancy creates a new Potatoverse metaphor
findings.finding: Potato tubers undergo natural dormancy after harvest, and sprouting indicates renewed growth activity.
findings.interpretation: The Potatoverse can distinguish dormancy from death: hidden life may be inactive without being extinguished.
findings.source: University of Florida Extension; University of Maine Extension

findings.title: The Twin is a problem of identity, not merely duplication
findings.finding: Thomas's name already encodes twin imagery, while the Potatoverse turns the twin into a relational question: how can two identities mirror one another without becoming identical?
findings.interpretation: This can become a central philosophical node about identity through relation and difference within unity.
findings.source: Thomas textual corpus plus Potatoverse canon

findings.title: Doubt becomes an epistemological virtue in the Thomas branch
findings.finding: Thomas is remembered in John through a demand for direct encounter with the risen Jesus before accepting testimony from others.
findings.interpretation: The Potatoverse can reinterpret doubting Thomas positively: doubt demands that claims survive contact with reality.
findings.source: Gospel of John; Thomas reference scholarship

findings.title: The Door and Thomas share an encounter grammar
findings.finding: The canonical Thomas narrative turns on questions, thresholds, absence/presence and direct encounter; the Potatoverse Door represents such a threshold.
findings.interpretation: Thomas can therefore connect to Door through a shared symbolic grammar of access to knowledge through encounter.
findings.source: Gospel of John and Potatoverse canon

findings.title: The Potato is an anti-palace symbol
findings.finding: The Potato begins underground, ordinary, edible and easily overlooked rather than in a throne room.
findings.interpretation: Cosmic language is forced through a mundane object. Grandeur must survive contact with dirt.

findings.title: Mud is substrate, not merely bottom
findings.finding: The Potatoverse repeatedly places the Potato in mud and below the surface.
findings.interpretation: Below should not automatically mean lesser: roots, storage, decomposition, soil and hidden labor are below the surface but indispensable to visible life.

findings.title: Tree of Strife is the failure of circulation
findings.finding: Tree of Strife is defined as a fractured tree in which fear, extraction and fragmentation replace reciprocal life.
findings.interpretation: A systems reading is that strife appears when flows stop renewing the nodes that generate them: resources leave roots, branches stop coordinating and fruit no longer creates seed.

findings.title: Spudlight is illumination from below
findings.finding: Spudlight is defined as light emerging through grounded ordinary life rather than descending only from abstract heaven.
findings.interpretation: Knowledge can emerge from matter, labor, memory and the overlooked.

findings.title: The Potatoverse can be read as compression and decompression
findings.finding: The Potato stores a future plant in compact underground form; the Tree expands hidden potential into visible structure.
findings.interpretation: Core cycle: compression → dormancy → recognition → sprouting → expansion → fruit → recompression into seed/tuber → renewal.

findings.title: The Potatoverse is fundamentally relational
findings.finding: The strongest recurring motifs are relationships: Father/Son, Twin/Mirror, Source/Manifestation, Root/Fruit, Door/Passage, Tree/Strife, Red/Blue and North/South/East/West.
findings.interpretation: The correct backend representation is a graph of transformations and dependencies, with prose pages acting as readable views over it.
findings.source: Frame, tree, node and relationship layers

findings.title: The Potatoverse should remain multi-layered
findings.finding: The corpus contains at least five distinct layers: contemporary public persona material, historical Christian texts, biological potato science, comparative traditions and original Potatoverse invention.
findings.interpretation: Flattening these layers would destroy the ability to show where a symbol comes from and how it changes in the new mythology.

findings.title: The eye is a hidden bridge between biology and perception
findings.finding: The potato eye is literally a node/bud containing future growth, while the Potatoverse already contains Door, perception, pineal and observation motifs.
findings.interpretation: New sub-branch: Eye → Perception → Recognition → Sprout → Branch.

findings.title: The mother tuber is a model of inheritance
findings.finding: A mother tuber transfers stored nutrition into the next generation before the new plant establishes its own system.
findings.interpretation: Inheritance can be modeled as stored capacity enabling another form to emerge, without requiring a supernatural claim.

findings.title: The Son can be modeled as a transition state
findings.finding: Across the Potatoverse, the Son is placed between Father and World, Door and Plane, Spirit and Matter, death and renewal.
findings.interpretation: Rather than merely a node, Son can be modeled as a transition-state entity whose defining property is passage between layers.
findings.source: Potatoverse frame, tree and lore corpus

findings.title: Tim's symbolic power is strongest when constrained by responsibility
findings.finding: The developed public Potatoverse transcript turns grand cosmic imagery back toward repair and responsibility.
findings.interpretation: Internal corrective: the Father archetype cannot simply claim transcendence; it must answer for what its gaze produces.

new_questions: How did the Thomas/Twin tradition develop from John into Syriac Thomasine literature?
